༄༅/ /mgon po trakshad kyi chos 'byung dang gtor rgyag thams cad kyi man ngag gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos zhal rgyun gser gyi thig pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po trakshad kyi chos 'byung dang gtor rgyag thams cad

kyi man ngag gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos zhal rgyun gser gyi thig pa bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ legs ldan mgon po'i man ngag zhal rgyun gser gyi thig pa 'bri/ bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol/ rwa lo tsā gsum pa tā ra nā tha'i zhal rgyun bdud 'dul dbang phyug zhes bya ba'i mgon po gzhan las kyang nus mthu che bas mgon po trakṣad zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa ni/ sngon gyi shākya thub pas/ ri rab chen po'i rtse ru ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ / kyai bcom ldan 'das lags/ nag po chen po gdug pa can ni/ rgyud gang las sgrub/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa ji ltar gtad/ ma 'ongs pas rnal 'byor pas ji ltar sgrub/ sgrub pa'i yon tan ji ltar yod lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' bstsal pa/ bstan pa snyigs dus gtad pa'i rab lo rgyus rtsa ba bshad/ 'dir 'dus kyi 'khor tshogs rnams nyon cig /nag po chen po gcig la sgrub thabs rnam pa gsum du bshad/ de la lha trakshad dang*/ gnod byin trakṣad 'di rgyal po mya ngan med kyis nub gcig la mchod rten bye ba sgrub pa'i 'phrin las sgrub mkhan te mgon po 'di yin/ gsang ba bdud du sgrub pa 'di la yang nang gses su dbye na/ phyi'i srol bdag dkar po'i tshul du sgrub pa zhal lnga phyag bzhi pa mgon dkar tshul du yod/ nang gi mgon po sgrub pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ gsang ba bdud du sgrub pa zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa 'di la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dregs pa 'dur byed kyi rgyud le'u sum cu pa gsungs/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes nag po gcer bu'i rgyud le'u sum cu pa gsungs pa/ 'di kha'i nang nas rtsa ba'i mgon po gri thod can dang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs 'byung*/ rgyud spyan 'dren mkhan rgya lcags dam khang pa yin/ rgya lugs su grags/ yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nag po gcer bu'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum ma gsungs/

mgon po seng bzhon ma byung*/ jo bo lugs su grags/ rgyud 'phrin las man ngag gi snying po gsal ba zhes pa yod/ de'i nang du mgon po gri thod can dang*/ mgon po'i mi nag rta nag la bzhon pa/ bzlog pa'i mgon po yin par bzhed/ nag po bdun pa'i rgyud dang*/ dur khrod nag po'i rgyud du zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la/ 'khor gshin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad kyi bskor bar gsungs/ 'di la brten nas mgon po drug cu pa yongs/ sgrub pa la lag len skabs yin na/ 'di la phyi'i dkyil 'khor/ nang gi dkyil 'khor/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gsum/ phyir gzhi'i dam rdzas kyi gnad/ 'gyur ba ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad/ kyer sgom 'phrin las kyi gnad/ myur ba gsang sngags kyi gnad/ sa bcad 'di rnams las bzhi char la 'jug /dang po/ sa gzhi la dug dang khrag gis chag chag btab/ sa yi las bdun tshang bar bya/ gzhan lag len rnams zur na yod/ zor sna 'dren na 'di ru chang dang*/ khrag sna tshogs tshad dang*/ phur bu yungs dkar yungs nag dang*/ til dang ske tshe dang*/ shing dang zi ra dkar nag /rdo nag thun dang lcags phye zangs phye dang*/ kong zor rwa zor mda' zor dang*/ dam nyams dgra bo'i mkhar la rdobs/ nyin gsum thun rnams ni/ dgra bo gnod byed lus la rdobs/ dam rdzas legs pa'i le'u ste gsungs/ de rnams bsgrub dus su/ skam thun thams cad yaṃ dang hūṃ las bskyed/ rlon thun thams cad ma dang bhyo las bskyed/ sgrub dus bsad sngags la thun sngags btags la bzlas/ nyin mo pho thun brdebs/ mtshan mo mo thun brdebs/ de rnams bka' bzhi'i lag len gyi rim pa'o/ / sgrub pa lag len la 'jug ste/ mgon po zhal gnyis phyag gnyis phyag bzhi sgrub pa la/ yi dam stobs che la 'chun che ba gcig dgos/ de'i lo rgyus ni gnyos lo tsā ba'i bha ling a tsarya'i sku mdun du gser srang stong phrag gcig dus gcig tu phul nas chos zhu ba gsum byas/

khyad par nga yi khang pa la tshug cig tsam na yod pa'i/ de la chags pa bzhin du sdang ba yod pas/ chos skyong mthu rtsal can gcig dgos zhus pas/ mgon po 'di kho na gnang ba yin/ de'i rgyab rten du yi dam gshin rje gshed kyi dbang bskur rgyas pa gnang*/ da lta'i bar du yang rdo rje 'jigs byed dag tu mdzad pa 'di yin 'jigs byed gnyos lugs su grags pa yin/ khyad par mkhas btsun thams cad kyi 'jigs byed rwa la thug zer bar gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par rwa lo gsum pa'i zhal rgyun la/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa bum pa gcig nas gcig tu blugs pa lta bu yod/ nyi ma de ring yan chad la sgrub thabs kyis brgyud pa'i bar ma chad pa yin gsungs/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba yod gsungs/ sgrub thabs nyams len nyams su longs/ 'dir bsad bzlog gnyis dang*/ 'brel ba'i sngags 'di ltar bzla/ ral gri 'bar ba'i 'khrul 'khor bskor/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya hūṃ raṃ che/ ya me du ru ṇa yo da ya phaṭa ke /ya da yo ni ra yakṣe ya rbad mo/ yakṣe yatstsha ni ra ma ya dgra bo mar ya phaṭa/ bsad pa dbye bskrad rmongs rengs la/ ming gi yi ge'i 'bar bar du/ sngags kyi yi ge spel ba ste/ snying po nye snying steng du sngags de ltar bzla/ tshogs pa yongs rdzogs rnams gtso bo'i zhal phyag yongs rdzogs bskyed nas rgyun du bzla/ las byed slob dpon gyi drag cing zer nas nges par bzla/ de nas mdun bskyed bzlas pa man chad btang bas/ lha'i gtso mdzad lha trakshad/ gnod sbyin gtso mdzad gnod sbyin trakshad/ bdud kyi gtso mdzad bdud trakshad rnams sgrub thabs tha dad yod pa 'dra yang sgrub thabs tha dad du mi byed/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs 'di kha la rang rang sa bon byas pa'i mthus/ trakshad la 'bod sngags yig 'bru bcu bdun pa yin/ rwa lugs ni dam can chos rgyal la las kyi gshin rje mgon po nag po'i sgrub pa dang*/

lha mgon du sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i sngags de ltar byas pas lha gnyis gsum gyi nus pa yod bla ma'i zhal rgyun yin/ trakshad la yang de'i rigs 'gre ba go bar bya'o/ / de nas smad las bsad pa ni/ oṃ sla na ni byin no/ /snying la ya ya/ sutrī tsi ta rbad/ mahā ka la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka la tri yaṃ bhyo/ ṇi tshal ba dri dza yaṃ bhyo ṇi tshal pa/ che ge mo ma ra ya dzaḥ srog thig dbab pa'i drag sngags yin/ /srid gsum sgrol zhing phung bar byed/ /gzhu dang mda' dang mde'u tshul gsung*/ /nyin mo yab kyis 'dod pa la/ /rbad bsad gnyis po btags nas bzlas/ /yum la mtshan mo de bzhin no/ /rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros mgon po lcam dral gyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing*/ bran mo bran pho thams cad yang mig rtsa rig cing bka' la nyan nas las byed par bsgom/ bsnyen pa'i sngags rnams bzlas pa'i tshe/ mu tig bstar la brgyus bzhin bzla/ /sgrub pa'i sngags rnams bzla ba'i tshe/ /bar snang dgong gi thog bzhin bzla/ /las sbyor sngags rnams bzla ba'i tshe/ /hor ba gzan la 'dzum bzhin bzla/ /de rnams lag len song nas bskang ba 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrings/ btab gtor gyi bya ba la 'jug ste/ btab gtor bca' lugs kyi khyad par ni/ gtor ma gru gsum du byed pa dang*/ gru gsum chos 'byung bzo rgyu byed pa dang*/ mi gzugs brgya rtsa ru byed pa dang*/ mtheb skyu ru byed pa ni mgyogs chos yin/ 'di skabs su 'thor ba bsdu ba'i dmigs pa yang dgos/ de la sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'gugs par bya/ gtor chung 'bul ba'i sngags gtor sgrub nang na yod do/ / bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ gtor chung de dgra bgegs dngos su bsam nas mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du sha chom rus chom la rkan sgra dang bcas pas dgra bgegs gsol bar mdzad par bsam/

mdun bskyed kyi lha de yang*/ rnying ma ba la las lugs la gtor ma thog mar lhar gsal ba dang*/ bar du gtor ma gsal ba dang*/ mthar zol du gsal bar byed de/ gzhan dag de lta bu mi byed par mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma de nyid dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po dmigs nas mchod pa'i tshul du 'bul/ rang nyid dper na yi dam ri rab tsam du bsgom/ de'i bka' nyan chos skyong mdun bskyed kyi sked pa tsam du sleb par bsgoms nas/ las bcol ba'i dmigs pa byed pa yin/ bstod bskul rnams kyi gzhung bsrangs/ bskul ba'i dmigs pa ni/ mgon po dug kug kug zhing dgra la phyogs/ lha mo yang dgra bo khram la 'debs par bsam zhing nad sna drongs/ mtshon gyi gru gu'i 'gyed cing shwa dhe'u dkar nag 'dril/ mon mo rnams ni/ la la ngu zhing la la khro/ dgra la g.yab mo 'debs shing ngu*/ la la lag pa 'brel zhing nguu*/ la la gri thod la la ngu*/ dgra la ngu zug rtag tu byed/ khyi mo ral pa'i spu gseb nas/ dug dang mtshon cha lta bur 'phro/ dgra yi yul du yang yang song bar bsam/ drag tu rgyug cing drag tu mchod/ de ltar bsgom par bya/ mtshams 'di ru stod las byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ smad las drag las sgrub pa'i thabs kyi las la 'jug par bya ste/ mdun du 'brub khung dngos sam bris pa'i nang du ling ga skye mched dod par bya/ rang gi lag pa'i phur ba bsgril shing*/ hūṃ las byung ba'i nag po che/ /phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar/ /g.yon pa'i thod khrag zhal du gsol/ /sku smad dpal gyi dbyis chen ste/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i kī la ya/ /dam nyams snying la kī la ya/ /lag pa thabs shes sbyar ba las/ /sras mchog de ltar 'byung bar mos/ bden bdar lha'i gdangs dang ldan pa mang du bya/ 'di ru bsgral ba'i phan yon dang*/ ma bsgral ba'i nyes dmigs dang*/ tshangs pa rnam gsum dang*/ kha sbyor dbye ba dang*/ tshe lung dang*/

khrus lung dang*/ dgra bgegs kyi tshe lung dang*/ rnal 'byor ba'i tshe lung dang*/ dgra bgegs kyi khrus lung*/ khams gsum sems can khrus lung dang*/ rdo rje phur ba'i khrus lung ngo*/ /kha sbyor dbye ba'i lha la mchod pa 'di snga ba yin/ drug cu pa'i nang gi kha sbyor bzhi'i dbang du btang na/ gnas kyi kha sbyor dang*/ ye shes kyi kha sbyor dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i kha sbyor dang*/ go cha'i kha sbyor ro/ /gsang sde brgyad po yang kha sbyor yin te/ mi'i kha sbyor bzhi dang*/ lha'i kha sbyor bzhi ste/ lha'i kha sbyor bzhi ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i gsang sde/ tshe lha'i gsang sde/ yul lha'i gsang sde/ zhing lha'i gsang sde de bzhi'o/ /mi'i gsang sde bzhi ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gsang sde/ rje dpon gyi gsang sde/ grogs kyi gsang sde/ 'khor g.yog gi gsang sde/ gsang sde'i 'di'i rnams la mchod pa 'bul mi dgos pa'ang yod/ gsang sde brgyad po 'di rnams rgyud rtog pa gsum pa nas gsungs/ gshin rje gshed skor rnams 'di kha phyag len du mdzad/ la lar zhig gi chos skad la/ kha sbyor bzhi shes na shes dang ma shes na smra shes sam u tshugs byas yang kun 'dug /kyai rdo rje'i rgyud du kha sbyor gsum las ma gsungs/ nges med du gsungs/ dper na dmigs gsal can gyi dgra gcig la bla med kyi dbang bzhi thob pa yod na bum dbang gi kha sbyor dbye ba dang*/ gsang gi kha sbyor dbye ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi kha sbyor dbye ba dang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i kha sbyor dbye ba dang*/ dper na rtogs ldan dbang bzhi ma thob pa la sems ngo 'phrod pa yod na de'i kha sbyor dbye ba dang*/ 'khor lo dang rdzas dang yig 'bru'i kha sbyor dbye ba byas nas/ khrus lung gi dmigs pa gtad/ gzas pa po'i liṅga'i tshe lung dmigs pa rnams gtad/ rdo rje phur ba liṅga'i dkyil du bsnun pas/ rtsa thams cad gur gyi tshon thag bcad pa bzhin du song bar bsam/

khrag thag thams cad bye ma skam po la chu thig brgyab pa bzhin song bar bsam/ khrag gi dwangs ma lcog mo'i sgong nga dang 'dra ba yod/ de'i dbus na tshe rten a dkar po yod/ de phur pa'i rtse mos blangs te bla ma yi dam gang rung zhig gi thugs kar 'phang ngo*/ /lus khang stong 'dra ba de la thun dang phyag mtshan rnams rim bzhin btab/ gzas pa po'i sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i gnad khyad par can yod/ lus dum bur btang*/ de nas byin rlabs/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams la zhal bstabs kyi mchod pa gyer/ tshim zhing mnyes par bsam/ bla ma yi dam la phul bas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs/ dam can chos skyong la phul bas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs/ tshangs pa rnam gsum de la tshangs/ bsgral ba'i phan yon de la tshangs/ sgo dbye 'phreng sel gser skyems bden par bdar zhal bsgyur dang*/ zor bskul bar byas/ gzhan ma rnams kyi dbyangs rol gyer/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi rbod gtong dang dgra bo gsod pa bya/ sa nas blang nas 'phang tsa na/ srid pa gsum gyi nad dang dug dang 'khrul 'khor dang lha 'dre mi gsum gyi sdig pa dang*/ nus mthu thams cad tshang ba'i gtor ma ri rab tsam du bstim nas/ gzugs can gzugs med gang na gnas pa'i yul khams su 'phangs/ de dang mnyam du las byed pho nya las mkhan sde brgyad dang bcas pa dmag dpung gi tshul du song bar bsam/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung nas brlag par bsam/ gtor kha sbub/ de ltar byas pa'i rbod gtong dang dmag dang gtad mnan thams cad tshang bar bshad/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis rten mnan/ phyi mig mi blta bar rkang pa g.yas pa'i yi ge'am ri mo lnga 'bri/ de mtshams gcod kyi dmigs pa yin gyis/ de ltar mkhas rmongs thams cad la/ brgyag gtor mtshon char bsgoms nas rgyag pa 'dug ste/ rgyag lugs kyi dmigs pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa la dgra glo bur nyid du byung nas rgyag pa'i dmigs pa yin gyis/

mtshon char rgyag pa ltar nus pa thon pas bye brag gi dmigs pa yin no/ / rwa lo gsum pa tā ra nā thas zhal rgyun 'khrul med yin/ gong gi rgyag lugs de la yang*/ rang rang la sgom lugs mi gcig pa mtha' yas pa la sogs yod do/ /nged kyi 'di rnams sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang yod/ nang du 'ong nas tshogs dang bkra shis mtha' rgyas byed/ dkyil 'khor shul du me tog nges par 'thor/ /mkhas rnams lo rgyus phyag len btab/ /gsal bar blta bas me long yin/ /rab rib 'byed pas mig thur yin/ /rang bzo med pa'i zhal rgyun lags/ /zhes sa mo byi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi shu la dge slong snying po mtha' yas kyis bris pa ste brag stod chos kyi pho brang du dge'o// // gcig zhus// grub mtha'i mthar thug khyad par nges don snying po kun mkhyen gyi lta ba 'di ma gtogs pa'i grub mtha' khag khar gsang bar gyis shig sarba maṅga laṃ// < rigs 'dzin rnam snang rdo rjes zhus dag gnang ba'i dpe las bshus/ zhes zer ba 'dug kyang mi dag snyam/ > mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 188 -- PAGE 189 -- PAGE 181 -
